definitions.explanation: Studio Ghibli (スタジオジブリ), the Tokyo animation studio founded in 1985 whose films, many directed by {宮崎駿|みやざきはやお}, include My Neighbor Totoro and Spirited Away. ジブリ also stands for its films as a group.

examples.japanese: ジブリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だ。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、ジブリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I watched Ghibli films over and over.

examples.japanese: 『⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{千尋|ちひろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神隠|かみかく}し→神隠し：13736_kamikakushi⟧』⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ジブリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦アカデミー→アカデミー：10751_akademii⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Spirited Away is a Ghibli film, and it won an Academy Award.

notes:
The name is an Italian word for a hot Sahara wind, chosen to blow a new wind through Japanese animation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- スタジオジブリ: the full name
- ジブリ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ / ジブリ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: Ghibli films
- ジブリ⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: Ghibli-like (of a nostalgic countryside scene or a gentle fantasy look)
- となり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トトロ: My Neighbor Totoro (1988), whose character トトロ is the studio's logo
